operational_goals.title: Complete fleet inventory
operational_goals.description: Enumerate and register every Android device you own or manage. Every device must have a complete entry in device-registry.json including serial, model, Android version, security patch, battery, and storage.
operational_goals.success_criteria: All devices visible via 'navig skill run device-inventory', all registered in device-registry.json, all reachable via adb-connect (USB or wireless).

operational_goals.title: Establish automated morning device check
operational_goals.description: Configure the morning-device-check workflow to run automatically at 08:00 daily. Results (fleet status, battery, offline devices) should be written to memory and surfaced in the inbox.
operational_goals.success_criteria: Workflow runs on schedule, produces a readable fleet summary, offline devices and battery warnings surface as entries in known-issues.json.

operational_goals.title: Debloat and harden every device
operational_goals.description: Run debloat-sweep against each device using the safe debloat catalog. Disable carrier/OEM bloat reversibly and audit dangerous permissions. Nothing removed outside the vetted catalog.
operational_goals.success_criteria: debloat-catalog.md fully populated. Each device has had a permission audit. Over-privileged apps flagged in known-issues.json. All removals reversible.

operational_goals.title: Configure automated nightly backup
operational_goals.description: Establish the nightly-backup workflow to pull media and back up key app data from every device to backup_dir. Verify integrity each run.
operational_goals.success_criteria: nightly-backup workflow runs without errors. Media is pulled and verified. A quarterly restore drill succeeds on a spare device.

operational_goals.title: Verify a full backup restore
operational_goals.description: Restore one device's backup and media from devices/backups onto a spare or reset device to prove the nightly-backup output is usable.
operational_goals.success_criteria: A restore completes with apps, media and settings present; the result is recorded in known-issues.json if anything was missing.
